runs.question: Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
runs.answer:
[Turn 1 | session=ses_0c334912fffeBUsG61la8mDi32] Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
The query returned **7180 mainnet blocks** for 20 June 2026 with their first-seen arrival times (in ms from slot start). The data includes:

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `slot` | Beacon slot number |
| `slot_start_date_time` | Wall clock when the slot started (UTC) |
| `block_root` | Beacon block root hash |
| `first_seen_ms` | Earliest time any node observed the block (ms after slot start) |
| `observer_count` | Number of distinct nodes that reported seeing it |

Block slots ranged from **~14590523** (00:00:11 UTC) to **~14597998** (23:59:59 UTC). First-seen times varied from as low as **215 ms** to over **3,700 ms** depending on the block, with ~157–158 observing nodes per block on average.

The full output was saved to `/tmp/panda-opencode-3qcl6z35/share/opencode/tool-output/tool_f3ccbbdd8001pw4qP91IAlknmL`.

- **Host path**: `/home/runner/.panda/data/storage/6d8c4eaa320f/d30483ba-83cc-4640-affb-c74bd64e733e/arrival_histogram.png`

The histogram shows the distribution of first-seen block arrival times (in ms from slot start) for all mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026, with most blocks arriving within ~2 seconds and a tail extending past 3.5 seconds.
